affected_party: operators and governance reviewers deciding whether a quarantined Skill dependency may return to use
actual_problem: QIF records quarantine candidates and decisions but cannot yet prove what containment, remediation, replay, observation, and residual-risk evidence supports a safe re-entry decision
why_it_matters: A quarantine decision without outcome and re-entry evidence can become indefinite blocking or premature restoration, either of which can cross organizational loss boundaries
why_now: v0.8.17 deliberately stops at quarantine review, while current incident-response guidance requires verified baselines, replay, observation, residual-risk documentation, and accountable recovery decisions before resumption
